sample.txt: Wow this makes sense! (And wow did I hate the type 1, 2, etc.)

For the cath lab, the key change: procedure-related MI now uses identical criteria after PCI and after CABG, within 30 days, and the arbitrary troponin multiples are removed - no more >5x URL for type 4a, no more >10x URL for type 5.

Why they went: after cardiac surgery 97.5% of patients exceeded 10x URL, and >218x URL (95% CI 40-318) was needed to flag peri-procedural risk. Diagnosis now needs a coronary complication plus imaging of new damage.
